## About the symposium

Thank you for your interest in the 5^th^ Early Career Researcher Symposium (ECRS2026) of the International Fossil Coral and Reef Society! 

The symposium is a one-day online, free-to-attend event, with the aim of filling the gap between the four-year cycle of our main symposium (every four years). The event is open to researchers of all career stages, with talks delivered exclusively by invited Early Career Researchers.

As part of the symposium, we will have 'Meet the Lab' presentations, in which different labs from all around the world will talk about their research themes and any opportunities available---a perfect opportunity to network with fellow researchers and encourage future collaborations.

**We will have more information to share with you in early 2026.**

On behalf of the organising committee, we look forward to seeing many of you there!

Alison Cribb and Amanda Godbold 🪸
